name: console-chat-loading-notice
goal: Describe a pending project connection without claiming read-only access

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: While a project connection is pending the composer is disabled but its notice incorrectly says read-only. Loading, connection errors and confirmed read-only access need distinct messages.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: The existing console loading capture asserted only the disabled composer. The catalog and existing project-agent store test now check the notice and preserve error and read-only cases.

steps.title: Strengthen the existing standardized test; commit it before repair, run it failing with loop record --phase red, and preserve the assertion.
steps.evidence: The committed loading catalog assertion failed on harbor-mbp-2; the desktop unit test also observed the incorrect read-only notice.

steps.title: Implement the smallest repair without weakening the regression test.
steps.evidence: Show a loading notice while the workspace is busy, after prioritizing connection errors; annotate the store factory return type.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
steps.evidence: The unchanged loading catalog assertion passed on harbor-mbp-2, and the desktop store unit tests also pass at the repair commit.

steps.title: Run relevant project checks and affected UI browser flows with fresh inspected screenshots and no unexpected browser errors; preserve diagnostics and keep pending until proof passes.
